name: Astrid Christensen
bio:
Astrid's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, through a university project focused on optimizing team dynamics under pressure. Her background in organizational psychology and a keen interest in high-performance environments led her to Arrow McLaren. Astrid firmly believes that a team's success hinges on a supportive and well-managed workforce. 

At Arrow McLaren, Astrid is dedicated to creating an inclusive and motivating atmosphere. Her approach balances data-driven analysis of employee performance with genuine care for individual well-being. She's known for her rigorous performance reviews and for championing professional development opportunities within the team, ensuring everyone is equipped to perform at their best.

What sets Astrid apart is her ability to remain composed and decisive even during high-stakes situations. She possesses a remarkable talent for mediating conflicts and fostering collaboration, making her an invaluable asset to the team's overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair typically worn in a neat braid or ponytail.
physical.description: Astrid has a slender build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized desk.
Prefers herbal tea over coffee, and always has a thermos on hand.
Insists on punctuality for all meetings, even by a minute.
